verdict.rationale: Phaser is a client-side JS/TS library, so its closest equivalent to an OpenAPI spec is its own full TypeScript definitions, which ship in the package's types folder and are machine-readable by editors and agents. No OpenAPI or Swagger document exists: all candidate paths returned 404, and the hosted examples API (GET /api/v1/examples/{id}) has no published spec. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/JSON API spec (all probed paths 404), a spec for the hosted examples API, and documentation positioning the type definitions as a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Full TypeScript definitions can be found inside the types folder
modern editors such as VSCode will detect them automatically.
